name: obsidian-handnote
description: Apple Pencil-first handwriting plugin for Obsidian
author: Yanzhe Shao

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/build-embedded-ort.mjs && node scripts/build-worker.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.public.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run package && npm run check:release
scripts.verify:private: npm run typecheck && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --private && node scripts/build.mjs production --private && npm run package && node scripts/check-release.mjs --private
